policy.intake: Every package is pinned to an exact version, locked in packages.lock.json, and recorded here with licence, source, purpose and review notes before it ships.
banned: Any package with an open Critical/High advisory
Packages that phone home, obfuscated packages, or install scripts that download binaries
GPL/AGPL code in a shipped binary without legal review

dependencies.name: Avalonia
dependencies.purpose: Cross-platform UI shell for Kickl.Browser and the device emulator (ADR-001)
dependencies.review: Pinned official Avalonia release. Managed UI library; native rendering arrives through SkiaSharp/HarfBuzzSharp below. Licence and transitive tree inspected from packages.lock.json.

dependencies.name: Avalonia.Desktop
dependencies.purpose: Desktop platform bootstrap (windowing, input) for the browser and emulator
dependencies.review: Pinned official Avalonia release; part of the same reviewed family.

dependencies.name: Avalonia.Themes.Fluent
dependencies.purpose: Base control theme that the Kickl token/theme layer overrides
dependencies.review: Pinned official Avalonia release; no native code.

dependencies.name: Avalonia.Svg.Skia
dependencies.purpose: Static inline SVG rendering for the sanitized sealed-page visual block (ADR-015)
dependencies.review: Community package; renders already-sanitized static SVG only. Must be audited alongside the SVG sanitizer before release. Adds native Skia dependencies.

dependencies.name: HtmlAgilityPack
dependencies.purpose: Parsing the sanitized inline HTML/SVG fragment before native rendering (ADR-015)
dependencies.review: Managed parser with no native code; runs behind the allowlist sanitizer and is treated as untrusted-input code. Fuzz target still required (G4).

dependencies.name: BouncyCastle.Cryptography
dependencies.purpose: Argon2id PIN key derivation (RFC 9106 p=4) and Ed25519 signature verification
dependencies.review: Pinned official Bouncy Castle package; dependency tree and package licence inspected. Used for Argon2id and Ed25519 verification in the hybrid registry-snapshot verifier; ML-DSA-65 comes from .NET 10 MLDsa. RFC vectors, performance tuning, and external crypto review remain release checks.

dependencies.name: SkiaSharp.NativeAssets.Linux
dependencies.purpose: Native Skia binaries for Linux rendering, pinned to the managed SkiaSharp version
dependencies.review: Added as a direct pin: Avalonia.Skia requests 2.88.9 while Avalonia.Svg.Skia pulls managed SkiaSharp 3.116.1, so the Linux native assets must be raised to 3.116.1 or Skia fails at runtime. Runtime paint still needs verification on an Ubuntu host.

dependencies.name: HidSharp
dependencies.purpose: Experimental USB HID dongle transport in the device emulator; not the selected product transport
dependencies.review: Used only by the experimental KHF1 transport. The product dongle transport is Wi-Fi (docs/19 §9), so this dependency should be removed or explicitly justified before release.

dependencies.name: xunit.runner.visualstudio
dependencies.purpose: VSTest adapter for running the xunit suite (not shipped)

dependencies.name: Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk
dependencies.review: Test-only; Microsoft-signed package, excluded from shipped artifacts.

dependencies.name: coverlet.collector
dependencies.purpose: Coverage collection for the Core test suite (not shipped)
dependencies.review: Test-only; no coverage percentage gate is enforced yet.
